title: Planting Cowpea Protocol
author: Stephanie Cullum
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rpnd5me

steps.title: Prepare Materials
steps.instruction: Collect 48 plastic 4 gallon plant pots for cowpea planting.

steps.title: Prepare Soil Mixture
steps.instruction: Create a soil mixture consisting of one part LC1 soil (Sun Gro Horticulture Professional growing mix SS#1-F1P RSI) and one part calcined clay (Turface Athletics MVP 32217).

substeps.instruction: Mix in smaller portions for easier mixing (e.g., 10 scoops of 2 quarts each, alternating clay and soil, in a large pot).
Mix the dry mixture with a shovel or hands until distribution is even.

steps.title: Hydrate and Fill Pots
steps.instruction: Moisten the soil and fill the prepared pots.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 litres of water to the soil and mix to ensure equal moisture.
Fill all pots with the mixture, leaving 3 cm of space from the lid of the pot.
Pat down the soil gently to provide firmness while still allowing movement for seeding.

steps.title: Plant Cowpea Seeds
steps.instruction: Plant 2 seeds per pot for each of the 12 cowpea accessions (4 pots per accession, totaling 8 seeds per accession).

substeps.instruction: Create a hole 2 cm deep in the soil using a fingertip.
Place the seed in the hole and cover with soil.
Ensure the 2 seeds in each pot are planted 7 cm apart and located near the centre of the pot.
Repeat for all pots, labelling each pot with the corresponding accession number.

steps.title: Initial Watering
steps.instruction: Thoroughly water each pot once the seeds have been planted.

steps.title: Maintain Plants
steps.instruction: Monitor the growing plants once a day.

substeps.instruction: Rewater all pots if the soil becomes dry.
